title: userquery
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, owninguser.

advancedgroupby.description: Type the column name that will be used to group the results from the data collected across multiple records from a user view.

columnsetxml.description: Shows the columns and sorting criteria for the saved view, stored in XML format.

conditionalformatting.description: Type information about how the items in the user view are formatted.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

description.description: Type additional information to describe the saved view, such as the filter criteria or intended results set.

enablecrosspartition.description: Tells whether the view can retrieve data from all cluster partitions.

fetchxml.description: Contains the Fetch XML query that defines the entities and attributes included in the saved view.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

name.description: Type a descriptive name for the saved view.

offlinesqlquery.description: String specifying the corresponding sql query for the fetch xml specified for offline use.

querytype.description: Shows the code for the query type to indicate whether the saved view is an address book filter, advanced search, or other view.

returnedtypecode.description: Type of entity that the saved view displays.

statecode.description: Shows whether the saved view is active or inactive.

userqueryid.description: Unique identifier of the saved view.

versionnumber.description: Version number of the saved view.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

_ownerid_value.description: Enter the user or team who is assigned to manage the record.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Shows the business unit that the record owner belongs to.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns this saved view.

_owninguser_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who owns this saved view.
